event.intro_lead:
Two events run during the festival.
Your ticket is a raffle entry, and the leaflet is a stamp card.
event.ticket_summary: Tear off the entry stub on your screening ticket and drop it in the box. Winners of Baemin gift cards are drawn at the closing ceremony.
event.ticket_step_1: Get a ticket for each screening
event.ticket_step_3: Tear it off and drop it in
event.ticket_more: More tickets, more chances to win! 🍀
event.ticket_draw: Draw: live at the closing ceremony, Fri 11/20, 3rd → 2nd → 1st
event.ticket_attend: Prizes are handed out on the spot to winners who are present. If a winner is absent, we draw again.
event.stamp_summary: One stamp per screening session on your leaflet. The more you collect, the more gifts you get.
event.stamp_step_1: Pick up a leaflet at the info desk
event.stamp_step_2: Watch a film, stamp in any color
event.stamp_all: Gifts stack! Fill all 5 and take home all three ✨
event.stamp_where: Claim gifts in front of the screening hall
event.stamp_rule: One stamp per session. Claimed gifts are checked on your leaflet.
event.cta_text: Which film will you start with?
